title: The Last Salt Anew
author: T. M. Thackeray
blurb: Sable Delacroix, an exiled storm-caller, has spent twenty years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. But when tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must find the door out of a country that no longer exists before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
